cli.a.ask:
Send a message and print the reply, in a new session unless -c or -s. If
subagents or background commands are started, wait for their reports and the
final reply. Without a message, read it from standard input; with - in the
message, append standard input to it. The reply goes to standard output, the
steps to standard error.
cli.a.config: Open the settings screen. The settings file is ~/.config/litemiyu/config.toml.
cli.a.root: Without a command, open the full-screen interface.
cli.child_behind: some of a subagent's messages may be missing
cli.denied.hint: add --yes to allow risky commands that need confirmation in this run
cli.denied.many: {count} steps needed confirmation and were skipped
cli.denied.one: 1 step needed confirmation and was skipped
cli.end.jobs_stopped: ; the subagents and background commands that had not reported were stopped
cli.hint.duration: use a duration such as 30s, 10m or 1h
cli.no_model: no usable model: none is set up
cli.not_utf8_arg: an argument is not UTF-8 text
cli.o.ask.bare: No features: no tools (new sessions only)
cli.o.ask.cd: Work in the given directory (new sessions only)
cli.o.ask.file: Append this file's path to the message; repeatable
cli.o.ask.format: Output format (default: text); jsonl: one event a line
cli.o.ask.model: Use this model; a continued session keeps it
cli.o.ask.rescue: Rescue mode: saves nothing to disk (new sessions only)
cli.o.ask.yes: Allow risky commands that need confirmation
cli.o.root.bare: First session without features: no tools, no context
cli.o.root.rescue: Rescue mode: saves nothing; only a minimal set of tools
cli.rescue_missing: no usable model for rescue mode, missing {missing}
cli.rescue_no_config: the settings screen is not available in rescue mode (rescue mode saves nothing to disk)
cli.s.ask: Send a message and print the reply
cli.stdin_not_utf8: standard input is not UTF-8 text
cli.taken: session {id} is open in another window
cli.taken_above: session {id} belongs to a subagent, and session {parent} that started it is open in another window
cli.v.name: <name>
cli.wait: · Waiting for {what} to report… (Ctrl+C stops waiting)
cli.x.ask:
No one can confirm risky commands while ask runs: catastrophic ones are always
refused; ones that need confirmation are refused and reported at the end
(exit 4) unless --yes is given.

Exit status:
  0  The turn ended normally
  1  An error occurred, e.g. a model error or the session is open elsewhere
  2  Bad arguments
  3  Interrupted, or --timeout or --max-steps reached
  4  The turn ended, but some steps needed confirmation and were skipped
  5  No usable model

Examples:
  litemiyu ask "What does this project do"
  cat error.log | litemiyu ask "Why did this fail" -
  git diff | litemiyu ask --format jsonl "Review these changes" -
  litemiyu ask -c --format json "How do I run the tests"
cli.x.root:
Examples:
  litemiyu ask "What does this project do"
  git diff | litemiyu ask --format jsonl "Review these changes" -
  litemiyu -c
  litemiyu --version

The rescue provider can also come from LITEMIYU_RESCUE_BASE_URL,
LITEMIYU_RESCUE_MODEL and LITEMIYU_RESCUE_API; the key only from
LITEMIYU_RESCUE_API_KEY.

Run 'litemiyu help <command>' for more on a command.
